148:t_017:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I know! We cannot allow that machine to exist!」

148:t_017:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll use $$トランザムバースト$$!」

148:t_018:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$! We've learned that your machine spreads nanomachines to damage both machines and pilots!」

148:t_018:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The dense particles from $$トランザムバースト$$ can stop them functioning!」

148:t_020:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is this the power of $$ＧＮ粒子$$ and the $$サイコ・フレーム$$...?!」

148:t_022:2.en:
$n
「Thank you, Captain $$アムロ$$... Your words let me... overcome his venom...」

148:t_022:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Was mine the only voice you heard?」

148:t_022:4.en:
$n
「I think... I also heard Ms. $$スズネ$$'s voice...」

148:t_022:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Are you all right, Ms. $$スズネ$$?」

148:t_022:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Y-yes, I am... I was almost unconscious, so I didn't really know what was happening...」

148:t_022:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
(She has no memory of that time...?)

148:t_022:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...I don't like this, $$いがみ合う双子$$...」

148:t_023:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even with your allies' help, I can't accept that you overcame my venom.」

148:t_023:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear... This looks like it's going to get ugly...」

148:t_023:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$サルディアス$$... Stand back.」

148:t_023:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yeees... I'll do that this time.」

148:t_024:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... And $c... The real battle starts now.」

148:t_025:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$アンタレス$$ and I will take you on...」

148:t_025:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And I'll burn this entire city to ashes!」

148:t_025:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That mental attack on $n...! Were you the one who amplified their hatred of me?!」

148:t_025:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right. But my power doesn't create something from nothing.」

148:t_025:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「They hated you in their hearts! Don't forget that, $$ゼロ$$!」

148:t_025:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I've known that for a long time.」

148:t_025:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I know that nothing I do can atone for my sins...!」

148:t_025:8.en:
$$スザク$$
「But we'll still fight, for the people who entrusted their future to $$ゼロ$$!」

148:t_025:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's the only thing we can do!」

148:t_025:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't think that self-satisfaction can defeat my hatred, you scum!」

148:t_026:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... That man is dangerous.」

148:t_026:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But if we beat him, $$サイデリアル$$ should withdraw...! This is our chance!」

148:t_026:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「During our assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$ in North America, his power forced us to retreat.」

148:t_026:4.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「But with $$新日本$$'s forces joining us...」

148:t_026:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Can you hear me, $$ゼロ$$? We only have the resources to keep fighting for six more minutes.」

148:t_026:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we can't defeat him by then...」

148:t_026:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「You mean we'll abandon $$トウキョウ$$...?!」

148:t_026:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll win in those six minutes...! All units, focus your attacks on him!」

148:t_026:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Be very careful of the enemy $$スフィア・リアクター$$! That machine creates a special field around itself!」

148:t_026:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is that the $$スフィア・アクト$$ we heard about...?!」

148:t_026:15.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It seems that power differs for each $$リアクター$$.」

148:t_026:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Give it everything you've got! We defeated $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$. We can do this!」

148:t_026:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You'll spend those six minutes in hell.」

148:t_027:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... That man is dangerous.」

148:t_027:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But if we beat him, $$サイデリアル$$ should withdraw...! This is our chance!」

148:t_027:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「During our assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$ in North America, his power forced us to retreat.」

148:t_027:4.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「But with $$新日本$$'s forces joining us...」

148:t_027:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Can you hear me, $$ゼロ$$? We only have the resources to keep fighting for five more minutes.」

148:t_027:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we can't defeat him by then...」

148:t_027:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「You mean we'll abandon $$トウキョウ$$...?!」

148:t_027:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll win in those five minutes...! All units, focus your attacks on him!」
